resources.string: This app checks every incoming text message for sensitive content - like OTPs and bank alerts - and hides it until you unlock it with your fingerprint or PIN.\n\nTo see incoming messages, Android requires this app to be set as your DEFAULT messaging app. Nothing is sent anywhere - all checking happens on your phone.
Still not set as default - please select this app in the next screen.
